directorates._note: Resources and Digital (S151 Collins) + Corporate Services and Governance + Economy/Housing/Environment. Carries the bulk of the 10.872m budget cuts.

cross_cutting._note: Balancing GBP 16.785m (10.872m budget cuts + 5.913m social-care interventions); engine risk-adjusts to ~GBP 10.84m EV. Service net budgets verified; savings split is a service-net-weighted allocation (flagged).

mtfs_period: MTFS gap GBP 42.054m over five years (2026/27 to 2030/31)

reserves._note: Reserves drawdown GBP 4.921m in 26/27; minimum General Fund Balance held at 3% of net budget; planned reserve use ends 26/27. Collection Fund deficit GBP 4.497m.

risks.risk: MTFS funding gap GBP 42.054m over five years (2026/27 to 2030/31), to be met by budget cuts and social-care interventions. Reform UK inherits a Labour-set budget; the first Reform-set budget is 2027/28. Reserves use ends 2026/27 with replenishment required from 2027/28.

DSG High Needs block may enter a deficit position; no Safety Valve agreement (the Safety Valve programme closed 1 April 2026, replaced by the High Needs Stability Grant, payable only after a DfE-approved Local SEND reform plan). The exact deficit figure is in the MTFS (s45898).

Adult Social Care (GBP 104.409m, the dominant spend) and Children's (GBP 60.150m) carry the social-care interventions (GBP 5.913m); demand-led delivery risk. Gateshead benefits from the Recovery Grant Guarantee (>=5% Core Spending Power uplift).

_inherited_budget_note: The 2026/27 budget was set by the outgoing Labour administration (26 Feb 2026). Reform UK won 7 May 2026 (first non-Labour control since 1973) and inherits delivery; the first Reform-set budget will be 2027/28.
